notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting any permanent.
Holding priority, activate any Mountain you control by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a copy of Mythos of Illuna targeting any basic Mountain you control.
Resolve the Mythos of Illuna copy, creating a token copy of the basic Mountain.
The basic Mountain token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Repeat from step 2.
